spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership and inventory read access remain backend-enforced. This returns one page; preserve nextCursor and continue until the exact Item is found or pages end.

description: Read one private page of existing physical Items matching an exact acquisition source, exact bins, or printing, finish and condition groups. Coordinate filters narrow source or group results.

acquisitionSource.description: Restrict results to one exact acquisition source, such as a bulk-import ID. Combine with bins or groups to narrow it further.

bins.description: Restrict results to these exact bin names, up to 25. Omit to search every bin.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

groups.description: Restrict results to these exact printing, finish and condition groups, up to 25. Omit to skip this filter.

condition.description: The condition to match, e.g. NM, LP, MP, HP or DMG. Required.

finish.description: The finish to match, e.g. nf, fo, etched or surge. Required.

limit.description: Maximum Items to return, 1 to 1000. Omit for the default of 20.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to read Items from. Required.

name: spellbook_inventory_items_query
